## Website Agent gateway

Receives only the two on-demand Website analytics actions that would otherwise exceed Vercel Hobby's 12-function limit. The public Vercel proxy first verifies the signed-in browser; this workflow then forwards that same token to the private agent container, which enforces workspace membership.

Webhook path: `/arak-agent-website`. Allowed body actions: `indexHealth`, `websiteExplain`.
